SAP SF Stories Reporting Consultant/Developer
We are looking for an experienced SAP SuccessFactors Reporting Consultant / Developer to join a reporting project focused on delivering high-quality reporting and analytics solutions using SAP SuccessFactors Stories .
Role Responsibilities:
Analyze and understand business and reporting requirements, translating them into clear technical solutions.
Work directly with internal business stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify expectations, and provide reporting guidance.
Translate business needs into intuitive, scalable, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance SAP SuccessFactors Stories reports and dashboards.
Support report testing, validation, troubleshooting, and refinement based on stakeholder feedback.
Ensure reporting solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.
Collaborate with project team members and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting processes, solutions, and best practices.
 Required Experience:
Solid experience in SAP SuccessFactors Reporting.
Hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Stories and Stories reporting/dashboard development.
Ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into effective reporting solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a project team.
Good understanding of reporting design and analytics concepts.
 Key Technologies:
SAP SuccessFactors Stories
SAP SuccessFactors Reporting
Report Design
Analytics

SAP SuccessFactors People Analytics
Experience working in business-facing reporting or analytics projects.
